reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getFillableCategories and setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg helpers and reuses getCategoriesWithTemplates/getCategoriesInFixedGroups; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own pre-existing copy of the selection rule.

duplication.why: The new 'include hidden' rule is written twice: as a conditional SQL clause in getFillableCategories and as a boolean guard in copyPreviousMonth's own exclusion check.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the month-wide selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where the other exclusions already live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' signatures and the selection helper change, plus a shared MonthWideArgs type.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but the hidden rule now has two homes and the actions mix three styles for the same argument (destructured default, args.includeHiddenCategories, positional boolean).

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies includeHiddenCategories in its own inline exclusion check instead of going through getFillableCategories (the bypass predates the change; the change extends it).

disguised_duplication.where: The include-hidden rule appears as an interpolated SQL fragment in getFillableCategories and as a reshaped boolean expression in copyPreviousMonth.
